title: T3 — delivery contract: the PM job's governed path

body.scope: the PM request-to-plan path, the dual-controlled gates, the change path and closure
obligations: every gate is approved by an actor other than its requester
a baseline mutation after the scope baseline cites an approved change request
closure resolves against the frozen baseline with a published closure review
body.acceptance: SPEC_V2 §12 T3: PM runs a request end to end; cannot approve its own gate; a baseline change requires a change request
